ignoreCommand: msg=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B 2>/dev/null); case "$msg" in *'[skip ci]'*|*'[ci skip]'*|*'[skip vercel]'*|*'[vercel skip]'*) echo 'Vercel: skip build ([skip ci] in commit message)'; exit 0;; esac; base=''; if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then base="$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA"; elif git rev-parse -q --verify 'HEAD^' >/dev/null 2>&1; then base='HEAD^'; fi; if [ -z "$base" ]; then exit 1; fi; files=$(git diff --name-only "$base" HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ $? -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$files" ]; then exit 1; fi; deploy=0; for f in $files; do case "$f" in docs/*|tests/*|test/*|scripts/*|tools/*|.github/*|icons/svg/*|icons/crop-preview/*|icons/png/48/*|icons/png/1024/*|img/*.src.png|img/ghmeeting_mascot.png|*.md|*.psd|*.ai|*.zip|*.pdf|.gitignore|LICENSE*) ;; *) deploy=1;; esac; done; if [ "$deploy" = 0 ]; then echo 'Vercel: skip build (only non-deployable files changed)'; exit 0; fi; exit 1
